When Paul Graham says something will "seem obvious in retrospect," stop debating and start repositioning.

Replit isn't just upgrading a product. They're making technical co-founders optional.

Distribution wins. What's your moat if building becomes free?
source_story_title: Replit Poised to Redefine 'Vibe Coding' with Major Product Update
source_story_summary: Paul Graham, co-founder of Y Combinator and one of the tech industry's most influential voices, posted that Replit CEO Amjad Masad showed him the company's latest developments, calling it a paradigm-shifting moment for AI-assisted coding. Graham's framing — that it will 'seem obvious in retrospect' — is a hallmark phrase he reserves for genuinely disruptive ideas, lending significant credibility to the signal.
